sample_descriptions.description: The track has a standard dance tempo of 133 BPM, typical of house, techno, and trance. The track features very dark and bass-heavy timbres with minimal high-frequency content. Most of the sonic energy is concentrated in the low frequencies (sub-bass and bass). The sonic character is moderately percussive with sharp transients. The track is loud and compressed, typical of club-ready dance music
